thread:
Alex K: Quick heads up — planning to enable feature flag activation_cascade tonight at 00:30 UTC. Rollout plan: 10% -> 50% -> 100% over ~30m. Need smoke owners and rollback readiness. Will cut the first 10% at 00:30. Anyone able to own smoke checks?
Miriam L: I can own smoke for the first 15m. I'll monitor p95 latency, error rate, and queue depth. Which metric thresholds should we use?
Alex K: Thanks. Thresholds: p95 increase > 25% or error rate > 0.5% -> pause. queue depth > 2x baseline for >2m -> pause. Also watch kv-cache miss rate. I'll post the toggle command and rollback steps.
Tony R: @Miriam L I'll be nearby for rollbacks. If you ask, I can flip the flag back. Also can we whitelist a few test tenants to watch traces?
Alex K: Good call. Whitelist tenants: redwood-int, billing-staging, demo-qa. I'll add rollout config. Toggle command (internal tooling):
``
redctl flags set activation_cascade --percent=10 --env=prod
redctl flags set activation_cascade --percent=0 --env=prod  # rollback
```
Josie: Do we have a safe default behavior? If kv cache isn't available does this flag fallback to older router?
Alex K: Yes — default_safe: true, fallback_router: 'legacy'. If flag unset or service error, runtime uses legacy route. Config snippet:
```
activation_cascade:
  safe_default: true
  fallback: legacy
```
CI Bot: deploy-bot: Canary ready. No schema changes detected. Smoke test job queued.
Miriam L: :thumbsup: I'll watch logs and synthetic checks. Plan to post status at +5m, +15m, +30m.
Tony R: If Miriam pings for rollback, I'll run the rollback command and notify infra.
Alex K: Thanks team. I'll start the 10% flip at 00:30. If nothing noisy after 15m, I'll lift to 50% at 00:45, then 100% at 01:00. Post any anomalies here. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/activation-cascade
Josie: :eyes: One more ask — please ensure we don't trigger per-tenant rate-limiters accidentally. Miriam, can you watch per-tenant throttles?
Miriam L: On it. I will keep an eye on tenant-throttle alerts and will notify if any threshold hits.
Alex K: :rocket: thanks all. I'll update this channel before starting.
